title: Temporal validation and drift monitoring
purpose: Tracks discrimination, calibration error, score distribution, and feature drift across time periods.
input: `Monitoring` sheet with period, actual outcome, score, feature 1, and feature 2.
outputs: Period-level AUC and Brier score, PSI and KS drift measures, review flags, and performance/drift charts.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
